verdict.rationale: Dialpad is a business phone and contact-center platform, so a phone menu that routes callers to teams is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an IVR, auto-attendant, or keypress menu. The closest items are related but different features: assigning operators to queued contact-center calls, AI voice agents that hand off to humans, and a vague line about designing custom voice experiences. None of these shows a press-1-for-sales menu.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams
